release.loopback_hosts.description: Hosts of a loopback http origin (the hermetic tests' fakes) that the release policy treats as not production (D-054); any other origin is the real host. Moved from github-client.loopback_hosts when the GitHub client left (D-293).

release.merged_prs_per_release.description: Merged PRs since the last release after which release.ready is emitted (or a milestone).
